title: Australia's Appen says being the Switzerland of AI boosts demand for its human testing
title_zh: 澳大利亚Appen表示，作为人工智能领域的瑞士，增加了对其人体测试的需求
summary: SYDNEY, Feb 27 (Reuters) - Australia's Appen, a big supplier of human assessment of artificial intelligence systems, said rising technology protectionism would boost demand in the United States and
summary_zh: 路透悉尼 2 月 27 日 - 人工智能系统人工评估大型供应商澳大利亚 Appen 表示，不断上升的技术保护主义将提振美国和澳大利亚的需求。

title: Wall St ends lower as AI fervor wanes after Nvidia results
title_zh: 英伟达公布业绩后，人工智能热情消退，华尔街收低

title: Citrini Scare Marked the Bottom, Says Fund Betting on Bounce
title_zh: 基金押注反弹，Citrini恐慌标志着底部
summary: The fund sold some of its top-performing stocks, including European luxury goods companies, to invest in beaten-down software stocks.
summary_zh: 该基金出售了一些表现最好的股票，包括欧洲奢侈品公司，以投资遭受重创的软件股票。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures slide after Nvidia-led slump dampens AI mood again
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克期货下跌，英伟达引领的股市暴跌再次打压人工智能情绪
summary: Wall Street saw a hefty tech sell-off led by Nvidia despite the company beating analyst expectations, highlighting investor demands.
summary_zh: 尽管英伟达超出了分析师的预期，凸显了投资者的需求，但华尔街仍遭遇了以英伟达为首的科技股大幅抛售。

title: Meta signs multi-billion-dollar deal to rent Google AI chips, The Information reports
title_zh: 据 The Information 报道，Meta 签署了数十亿美元的租赁谷歌人工智能芯片协议
summary: Meta Platforms has signed a multi-billion dollar deal to rent artificial intelligence chips ‌from Google to develop new AI models, The ‌Information reported on Thursday, citing a person involved in the talks.
summary_zh: 据 The Information 周四援引一位参与谈判的人士的话报道，Meta Platforms 已签署一项价值数十亿美元的协议，从谷歌租赁人工智能芯片来开发新的人工智能模型。

title: Earnings live: Block stock surges over 20% after Jack Dorsey cuts nearly half of staff, Dell stock jumps
title_zh: 财报直播：Jack Dorsey 裁员近一半后 Block 股价飙升逾 20%，戴尔股价上涨
summary: The S&P 500 was on track for double-digit earnings growth, with more than half of companies having reported Q4 results so far.
summary_zh: 标准普尔 500 指数有望实现两位数的盈利增长，迄今为止已有超过一半的公司公布了第四季度业绩。

title: Stock market today: S&P 500, Nasdaq retreat as Nvidia falls 5% despite stellar earnings
title_zh: 今日股市：标普 500 指数和纳斯达克指数下跌，英伟达尽管盈利出色，但仍下跌 5%
summary: Investors are assessing Nvidia's earnings report for a steer on the AI trade.
summary_zh: 投资者正在评估英伟达的盈利报告，以了解其对人工智能行业的指导作用。

title: These are the winners & losers of the AI scare trade
title_zh: 这些是人工智能恐慌交易的赢家和输家
summary: Investors have been favoring artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure while pulling back from software (IGV), as US stocks (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC) navigate renewed volatility.
summary_zh: 随着美国股市（^DJI、^IXIC、^GSPC）再次出现波动，投资者一直青睐人工智能 (AI) 基础设施，同时撤出软件 (IGV)。

title: Nvidia earnings, Apple CEO teases product launches: Tech Support
title_zh: 英伟达财报、苹果首席执行官预告产品发布：技术支持

summary_zh: 雅虎财经科技编辑丹·豪利 (Dan Howley) 在《市场主导》节目中剖析了当天的领先和趋势科技故事，其中包括人工智能芯片制造商英伟达 (NVDA) 股价在周四盘中下跌，该公司公布了第四季度财报，而苹果 (AAPL) 首席执行官蒂姆·库克 (Tim Cook) 则...
